(c) the number of such candidates is less than the
number of seats to be filled in a constituency,
the Panchayat Returning Officer shall
forthwith declare, in the prescribed manner,
all such candidates to be duly elected and the
Commission shall, by notification in the Official
Gazette, call upon the constituency to elect a
person or persons to fill the remaining seat or
seats:
Provided that where the constituency having
already been called upon under this sub-section,
has failed to elect a person or the requisite number
of persons, as the case may be, to fill the vacancy
or vacancies, the Commission shall not be bound to
call again upon the constituency, to elect a person
or persons until it is satisfied that if called upon
again, there will be no such failure on the part of
the constituency.
